about_short_description.short_description: Sky.Money is a DeFi company that provides stablecoin, staking, saving, and governance services.

product.name: USDS
product.description: Sky Protocol’s dollar-pegged native stablecoin, used for transfers, borrowing, and access to Sky’s savings and decentralized finance products.

product.name: sUSDS
product.description: A value-accruing, yield-generating stablecoin that provides access to the governance-set Sky Savings Rate while remaining redeemable for USDS.

product.name: SKY Staking Engine
product.description: A staking service for the SKY governance token that enables reward accrual, governance participation, and USDS borrowing against staked SKY.

product.name: stUSDS
product.description: A risk-capital token that supplies USDS liquidity for SKY-backed borrowing and provides variable, utilization-dependent returns.

product.name: Sky Vaults
product.description: A set of third-party stablecoin yield strategies, currently deployed through Morpho, supporting selected USDS, USDC, and USDT deposits.

product.name: Sky Ecosystem Rewards
product.description: A rewards module where users supply USDS to receive tokens or points distributed by independent Sky Agents and ecosystem partners.
